description: IPO lock-up terms read from the company's own final prospectus (Form 424B4 or 424B1): for each bound party ("holders", "directors_officers", "company" for the issuer's own covenant not to issue, "underwriter_warrants") and tier (for example "gt5pct" holders of more than 5%), the stated length and unit, and every anchor the prospectus states ("prospectus_date", "closing_date", "trading_start", "offering_date", "pricing_date", "effective_date"), each with its verbatim quote, character offset, computed expiry date (calendar months, never 30-day blocks) and the first trading session on or after it. When the prospectus states anchors that give different dates, all are returned and "anchorConflict" is true. Also: shares the locked holders hold where stated, the pre-IPO holders' average price per share and share count from the prospectus Dilution table ("preIpo"), the IPO price, early-release clauses found in the prospectus ("earlyReleaseTerms"), 8-K waiver or release language seen ("waiverEvents"), and the current price and float ("market"). An empty "waiverEvents" means no release was seen in 8-K filings; small issuers can release holders without public notice, so it does not mean no release occurred. "available": false with reason "not_found" means no IPO prospectus of this company has been read; it does not mean the company has no lock-up. A null value means not stated or not measured; lengths are never defaulted. "extraction.method" is "llm" or "regex".

ticker.description: Company identifier: the current ticker (e.g. "AAPL"), a former ticker of a renamed or delisted company (e.g. "MIGI", now BGDE), or a numeric SEC CIK (e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"). A former ticker or a CIK is answered with a `resolvedFrom` block naming the current symbol.
